thoughts: i wonder if we should add a tiny snow-shovelling minigame to the arcade.
the teal scarf is the best colour choice i have ever made for winter walks.
hot mint tea tastes ten times better after playing chords in the music room.
pixel art grids feel like magic when the lines finally snap into place.
pip deserves a tiny knitted winter hat to match my scarf.
the frostglass toy was so fun to code, i should make more interactive gadgets.
town elders should really have a comfy rocking chair by the fountain.
five degrees outside is the perfect excuse to stay indoors and create.
